remaining.detail: E0-COMPLETE-PARENT-OUTRIGHTS remains missing; NQ.c.0 calendar-front and NQ.OPT do not supply complete preceding-volume NQ.FUT outright universe. No eligible-date or market replay claim.
Root must freeze C01 RangePrimitive/ClockSelection neutral port and caller ownership before implementation; draft below is proposal.

Jumbo P-zone anchor, distance estimator, volume/volatility filter, selection, invalidation, calibration and minimum-average formula remain undisclosed. Small deterministic primitives do not replicate these.
L03 value/delta/profile shelves require M04/M05 certified exact anchor publications; known OHLC remains usable. Rolling generic VP is not source anchor replacement.
Official settlement/publication/revisions, auctions, weekly/monthly histories and valid bridges need separate supplied evidence and registered adapters; never rename close as settlement.

Reach, first-side order, departure, retrace/continuation/reversal, conditional overshoot, role ladders and future path forecasts require frozen label/model/evaluation experiments; geometry carries no probability.
UP-M12 graph decomposition, UP-L02 role-aware ladder, UP-L03 source/full-session/profile/value upgrades and all P0–P7 comparisons remain explicit obligations; minimum E0 is not unit closure.

Native-event future labels/fills/protection, actual fees, one-mini risk accounting, all days and fit/calibration folds are outside this primitive draft. No synthetic/scalar results establish performance.
JXA supplied archive covers 66 posts, with unrasterized videos and five named missing pictures; PIN080/081 truncated tails and imported helper sources unavailable. No inference of their contents.

Complete prefix through first event can certify O, complete suffix from last event through end can certify C. H/L require full coverage. Endpoint price/order/history remain separately required. Root assigns Herschel a minimal checked public F09 publication-request accessor. M12 consumes only the certified primitive; no consumer private-history access or whole-checkpoint copying per primitive.
